metadata.description: Configuration for Version 2 synthetic DNH-total monthly water-demand generator

geography.comment: Single area: combined Dadra and Nagar Haveli

demographics.comment: 2.5% annual growth; urban share starts at ~29%, grows slowly. Households scale with population.

rainfall.comment: Monsoon gets 65% of annual total; distributed within June-September. Lognormal-like positive process.

temperature.comment: Realistic DNH-like temperature range and seasonality

humidity.comment: Monsoon increases both max and min humidity

solar_radiation.comment: Related to sunshine but with independent noise

wind.comment: Weakly tied to monsoon; mostly noise

demand.comment: Litres per person per day baseline; will be converted to m³/month

seasonality.comment: Monsoon reduces demand (more water available), dry season increases

demand.comment: Modest: -0.0005 means 1 mm rainfall reduces demand slightly
40% of current demand explained by previous month's demand

reservoir.comment: Gradual response: doesn't jump instantly with rainfall or demand

groundwater.comment: Deeper = larger number. Slower response than reservoir; monsoon improves.

canal_discharge.comment: Supply-aware: rises with demand (within limits), falls in monsoon (more water in system)

realism.comment: Adds occasional climate/extreme-demand months and more natural state variability while preserving the 15-year monthly scope.

validation.comment: Monsoon mean rainfall must be at least 3.5x dry season mean
Monsoon mean humidity must be ~1.15x dry season mean
Monsoon sunshine should be ~75% of dry season (lower during clouds)
Max month-to-month population change should be <5%
